about: A long analysis in one session: twelve messages from loading a 96-well growth plate to a written summary, with plots along the way. Measures what a real-sized session costs: requests, context at the end, and the largest replies. The soft checks say the analysis was done, so that a cheaper run after a change isn't only a lazier one: the failed well (C07), the contaminated one (E10) and the saturated reading (B03) were found, and the redo used the new window. Tags: new_notebook, plots, size, long.
